title: Every agent, one inbox
summary: A redesigned Agents inbox shows which agents need you, the top bar is cleaner, and What's New keeps your full release history.

highlights.title: The Agents inbox
highlights.body: Agents are grouped into Needs you, Running and Done, with their real names and logos. Click one to open its exact chat or Terminal tab, and old failures no longer pile up.

highlights.title: A cleaner top bar
highlights.body: A setup progress pill opens the Getting started checklist and goes away once you're done. Getting started, What's New and Discord now live in your profile menu.

items.text: What's New now keeps your full release history.
